text.p: EROX Corp said Thursday it expects to report "a significant loss" in its second quarter, led by weak consumer sales of its Realm fragrances.
The company said it could not provide a precise estimate for operating results because sales historically come late in the quarter.

"The overall weakness in consumer sales and inventory contraction in the better department stores as seen in the first quarter appears to be continuing into the current period," chairman William Horgan said in a press release.
The First Call consensus EPS estimate for EROX is $0.07 per share in the second quarter and $0.29 for the year.

Horgan said the company is initiating immediate cost-containment efforts but did not elaborate. He also said programs are in place to reduce the company's dependence on a single class of trade for sales and earnings.
The company is also negotiating opportunities to broaden the market for its Realm fragrance product line, he said.
